text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Reorganisation gale hits Nigeria Airways as managing director and seven others are sacked.
- Manufacturers association directs its members to stop paying multiple levies by state and local authorities pending outcome of a verification by tax board that levies are legal.
- Electoral commission issues guidelines for local council elections.
- Visiting African human rights team may meet detained presidential claimant Moshood Abiola and other detainees.
- Alarmed by soaring demand for foreign exchange at weekly auctions, central bank asks banks to furnish it with detailed briefs on the end users of the forex they are buying.
- Despite complaint of dissatisfaction with existing oil joint ventures, Nigeria and Elf are to jointly invest about $1.4 million in three new projects.
- Electoral commission disqualifies many hoping to stand in Saturday's local council poll; parties rush to put forward replacements.
